title: Scania R620 FUPS Approved Aluminium Bullbar #21
description: Scania R620 high tensile aluminium FUPS approved Bullbar. The large opening in the lower bar allows the AEB (Advanced Emergency Brake) and the ACC (Adaptive Cruise Control) to operate without any interference from the cab protection awarded by the Bullbar. Dual tow points in the main channel. Combination indicator repeater/daylight running lights are recessed in the outer box uprights. Features four heavy duty high tensile aluminium box uprights and 6mm wall high tensile aluminium tube. Only 150mm Bullbar projection from the cab. Total weight=135KG
